title: Amazon refunds up to $1.5 billion over Prime sign-ups #Shorts
description:
The FTC settled with Amazon over how Prime enrollment and cancellation worked: a $1 billion penalty plus up to $1.5 billion in refunds. By September 2026 Amazon had paid over $845 million automatically.

No claim form is needed, and nobody should ask you to pay for a refund.

Sources: FTC press releases, 25 Sep 2025 and 17 Sep 2026 (read 11 Nov 2026).
